issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台只渲 60f——过冲回弹落座（60–70f）与落座后的静止都被截掉，“归位”没有落点
全屏特写用 transform scale(3.66) 放大位图，卡片标题和数字是糊的（Q2）
特写里是灰色骨架条卡片，放大后整屏只有几根灰条，读不出是哪张卡
投影只有一层纯黑 rgba，落座时卡片缺少接触感；背景 dashboard 在整个飞行中纹丝不动，只靠透明度变化
changes: 补 SHARED_ELEMENT_MORPH_DURATION = 130（0–35 特写 · 35–60 morph · 60–70 回弹 · 70–130 静止）；槽位 808,590/524×454/r14、25f bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)→1.03 + 10f out-cubic 回弹、位置/尺寸/圆角共用 p、投影 36/110/0.32→2/8/0.06、背景 0.9→1 提亮全部保持
特写放大改用 CSS zoom（布局级放大），3.66× 下标题、1,284、热力格按目标尺寸栅格化，边缘清晰
特写内容随 Phase 0 fixture 成为真实的 Deploys 卡（图标、12w chip、数字、热力图），与槽位里那张卡逐像素一致
投影改为两层：原参数的环境影 + 落地前 40% 进度才出现、落座最实的 1px 接触影，并补一圈随 p 显现的 1px 发丝边；阴影色改带色相的 #10121a
背景 dashboard 飞行中带 1.035→1 的后拉视差（钳位进度、以槽位中心为原点），像镜头从特写退回总览；p=1 时严格为 1，不影响槽位对齐
issuesEn: No duration constant, so the workbench rendered only 60f — the overshoot settle (60–70f) and the post-landing hold were cut, so the return had no landing
The full-screen close-up enlarged a bitmap with transform scale(3.66), so the card title and number were blurry (Q2)
The close-up showed a grey skeleton card; enlarged, the screen was just a few grey bars and you could not tell which card it was
A single pure-black shadow gave no contact on landing, and the background dashboard sat perfectly still through the flight, changing only its opacity
changesEn: Added SHARED_ELEMENT_MORPH_DURATION = 130 (0–35 close-up · 35–60 morph · 60–70 settle · 70–130 hold); the 808,590 / 524×454 / r14 slot, 25f bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)→1.03 plus 10f out-cubic settle, shared p for position/size/radius, 36/110/0.32→2/8/0.06 shadow and 0.9→1 background lift are unchanged
The close-up now uses CSS zoom (layout-level scaling), so the title, 1,284 and heatmap cells rasterise at their final size and stay sharp at 3.66×
With the Phase 0 fixture the close-up is a real Deploys card (icon, 12w chip, number, heatmap), matching the card in the slot pixel for pixel

The shadow has two layers: the original ambient values plus a 1px contact shadow that appears over the last 40% of the flight and is firmest on landing, with a 1px hairline edge fading in with p; shadow colour is the tinted #10121a

The background dashboard gets a 1.035→1 pull-back parallax during the flight (clamped progress, origin at the slot centre), like the camera backing out of the close-up; it is exactly 1 at p=1, so slot alignment is untouched
